observations: Photo 0 shows a black Nikon DSLR body with a lens attached; the Nikon logo is visible on the front.
Photo 1 shows the lens with markings that include 'AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm' and 'DX' (70-300mm class lens).
Photo 2 shows the camera from a side angle; there are visible scuffs/marks on the camera body (especially around the side/edges).
No photo clearly shows the exact camera model number (e.g., D3400) on the body or the rear screen.

claims.claim: Used Nikon D3400 DSLR Camera With 70-300mm Lens
claims.evidence: The lens in photo 1 appears to be an AF-P NIKKOR 70-300mm, but the camera body model (D3400) is not clearly readable in the provided photos.

claims.claim: working perfectly ok with no fault
claims.evidence: Photos show cosmetic wear/scuffs (photo 2), but no functional test results (shutter count, autofocus, buttons, sensor, battery/charger) are shown.

risks.risk: Camera body model may not be D3400 (could be another Nikon DSLR with similar look). Wrong model changes market value.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model name/number on the camera body (usually on the front/bottom/near the grip) or a photo of the rear info screen showing the model.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic Nikon DSLR with the 70-300mm lens, not specifically D3400.

risks.risk: Lens condition (focus ring, zoom mechanism, fungus/haze, scratches) and autofocus performance are unknown.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the front and rear lens elements (against light) plus a short video showing autofocus tracking on a subject at different distances.
risks.if_unproven: Price as lens with unknown optical condition (assume not perfect).

risks.risk: Camera functionality (shutter, sensor, buttons/dials, viewfinder, SD card slot) is unknown.
risks.proof: A short video of powering on, taking a photo, and reviewing it on the rear screen; include a shot showing the shutter actuation and menu navigation.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven/possible faults (worst-case for used electronics).

risks.risk: Cosmetic damage may be more than shown (could affect resale and handling).
risks.proof: Full-body photos from multiple angles showing all sides and the mount area, in focus.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (battery, charger, strap, caps, hood, memory card) can reduce value significantly.
risks.proof: A single photo laid out showing every included item (battery model, charger, caps, strap, manuals).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the camera body model number (to confirm D3400) and serial/bottom label if possible.
Photos of lens front and rear elements (against light) to check fungus/haze/scratches.
Video test: power on → autofocus on a subject → take a photo → review on screen.
Photo of included accessories laid out (battery + charger + caps/hood + strap + any cables).
response.reason: The lens appears to be a 70-300mm AF-P (photo 1), but the camera model (D3400) and the 'no fault/working perfectly' claim are not verifiable from the photos. Missing decisive proof prevents confident worst-case pricing.
